_README: Earned mentions: third-party articles that cite or quote a brand because a journalist-query response landed.
One row per landed article. Add with: python3 scripts/earned_mentions.py add --url <article> --outlet <name> --brand-domain <domain> [--query-id <id>]
The weekly .github/workflows/entity-backlink-watch.yml re-fetches every row and records whether it still resolves and still names the brand.
This ledger is the ONLY evidence base for a Wikidata item: scripts/earned_mentions.py wikidata-gate marks a brand eligible only with >= 2
independent earned URLs (distinct outlet hosts, none on a portfolio or network domain). Wikipedia stays earned-only: nobody writes a brand's own article.
